body:
_This is for demo purposes, the issue will be closed after the GOC fall meeting_

## Instructions

1. Pick a *random* gene from the list
2. log in to the [GO AI hub](https://ai.geneontology.org/)
3. Start a terminal with Claude Code running in it
4. Type `/gene-review ORGANISM GENESYMBOL` (substituting the organism and gene symbol exactly as it is below. You don't need the uniprot ID)
5. After ~5 minutes navigate to `/ai-gene-review/genes/ORGANISM/GENE/`
6. Click on the `GENE-ai-review.html` file
